about.title: About me
about.bridge: A <mark>bridge</mark> between business, Compliance, data and technology
about.p1: My profile combines Law, Global Governance, Business Administration and Management, and Strategic Business Analytics, a multidisciplinary background that allows me to understand the regulatory and corporate governance context and connect it with business needs, technology and data.
about.p2: At Nestlé I have progressed from an internship to Business Analyst, working at the intersection of business, Compliance and technology. During my on-mission assignment I took on Product Owner responsibilities, contributing to product evolution, requirements definition, adoption and the global rollout of Compliance Technology and Corporate Governance solutions.
about.p3: My work focuses on turning complex needs into clear, scalable digital solutions, connecting stakeholders, processes, technology and data in an international and multicultural environment.
about.p4: I am currently continuing to broaden this profile towards applying artificial intelligence and automation to business processes, with a particular interest in generative AI, Microsoft 365 Copilot, intelligent automation, AI Governance and Responsible AI, as a natural evolution of my experience in analytics and digital transformation.
